bio: Research Background Contact Us Christopher joined Boston Children's Hospital in 2023 as a biostatistician in the Biostatistics and Research Design (BARD) Center . He earned a Master of Science in Biostatistics degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 2023.
